annotations.title: Text analysis pack: readability, keywords, entities and safety

description: One call to analyse a text: length, reading time and readability grade, the top keywords and repeated phrases with their density, the emails, links, phone numbers, hashtags and mentions it contains, and a prompt-injection scan for text an agent is about to act on. Up to 20,000 characters, local processing. Cheaper than the four tools bought one by one. Use to review drafts, triage inbound messages or vet scraped content. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
